WHEREAS John J. Deviny, the Public 
Printer, will, during the month of June, 
1952, become subject to compulsory re­
tirement for age under the provisions of 
the Civil Service Retirement Act of May 
29, 1930, as amended, unless exempted 
therefrom by Executive order; and 
WHEREAS, in my judgment, the pub­
lic interest requires that the said person 
be exempted from such compulsory re­
tirement as provided below:
NOW, THEREFORE, by virtue of the 
authority vested in me by section 204 of 
the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 404 
(5 U. S. C. 715a), I hereby exempt the 
said John J. Deviny from compulsory 
retirement for age for an indefinite pe­
riod of time.
